## Temple High Priest (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
 Male human cleric 11  
 NG Medium humanoid (human)  
 **Init** -1; **Senses** Perception +5  

**Defense**

 **AC** 9, touch 9, flat-footed 9 (-1 Dex)  
 **hp** 110 (11d8+22)  
 **Fort** +5, **Ref** +8, **Will** +6  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** masterwork quarterstaff +9 (1d6+1)  
 **Special Attacks** channel positive energy (10/day, 6d6, Will DC 18), rebuke death (8/day), nimbus of light (11 rounds/day)  
 **Cleric Spells Prepared** (CL 11th; concentration +16)  

  6th—*[heal](../../magic/spells/heal.md)*<sup>D</sup> (2)  
 5th—*[breath of life](../../magic/spells/breath-of-life.md)*<sup>D</sup>, *[raise dead](../../magic/spells/raise-dead.md)* (3)  
 4th—*[cure critical wounds](../../magic/spells/cure-critical-wounds.md)*<sup>D</sup>, *[divination](../../magic/spells/divination.md)*, *[restoration](../../magic/spells/restoration.md)* (3)  
 3rd—*[create food and water](../../magic/spells/create-food-and-water.md)*, *[cure serious wounds](../../magic/spells/cure-serious-wounds.md)*<sup>D</sup>, *[remove blindness/deafness](../../magic/spells/remove-blindness-deafness.md)*, *[remove curse](../../magic/spells/remove-curse.md)*, *[remove disease](../../magic/spells/remove-disease.md)* (2)  
 2nd—*[cure moderate wounds](../../magic/spells/cure-moderate-wounds.md)*D, *[lesser restoration](../../magic/spells/restoration-lesser.md)* (3), *[remove paralysis](../../magic/spells/remove-paralysis.md)* (2)  
 1st—*[bless water](../../magic/spells/bless-water.md)* (4), *[cure light wounds](../../magic/spells/cure-light-wounds.md)*<sup>D</sup>, *[detect undead](../../magic/spells/detect-undead.md)* (2)  
 0—*[detect poison](../../magic/spells/detect-poison.md)*, *[mending](../../magic/spells/mending.md)*, *[purify food and drink](../../magic/spells/purify-food-and-drink.md)*, *[stabilize](../../magic/spells/stabilize.md)*  

   domain spell **Domains** Healing, Sun  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 12, **Dex** 8, **Con** 14, **Int** 10, **Wis** 20, **Cha** 16  
 **Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 18  
 **Feats** Combat Casting, Extra Channel (2), Great Fortitude, Improved Iron Will, Iron Will, Toughness  
 **Skills** Diplomacy +17, Heal +19, Knowledge (religion) +14, Sense Motive +19, Spellcraft +14  
 **Languages** Common  
 **SQ** aura, healer’s blessing, orisons, sun’s blessing
